diagnosis.details: PostgreSQL 18 exposes column NOT NULL constraints as named pg_constraint rows. The frozen migration requires an exact constraint-name array that omits those rows, so its fail-closed shape assertion rejects the freshly created table.
diagnosis.readOnlyProof: The exact CREATE TABLE executed inside an explicit rollback transaction produced the nine expected named constraints plus ten PostgreSQL 18 generated *_not_null constraints.
